`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
`set-version` does two jobs at once: bumps `[workspace.package].version` (which every crate inherits via `{ workspace = true }`, so `Cargo.lock` moves in lockstep) and rolls the `changelog.d/*.md` fragments into a dated `CHANGELOG.md` section. That "fragment → rollup" pattern is why the CI changelog gate can demand a fragment per PR without ever causing merge conflicts in the changelog itself.
